categories_thin: Electrical contractors: no walk-in electrical business with a commercial Highland Park address surfaced; licensing databases list only sole proprietors at residential addresses, which I did not record.

General contractors, roofing, painting, masonry and paving: Highland Park is largely built-out residential, so most firms that serve it are based in neighboring towns; only one roofing/exteriors firm (Eleven Exterior) has a Highland Park address.

Manufacturing and wholesale: only two manufacturers surfaced (Birnn Chocolates, Illuminating Experiences) plus a handful of contractor-supply firms; Highland Park's industrial pocket is small (Cleveland Ave).
No hotel, motel, self-storage, moving company, dedicated toy/sporting-goods store or music-instrument store appears to exist inside the borough.
caveats: Yellow Pages, Cylex and Localsolution all block automated access (403), so their listings are known only from search-result snippets and are marked 'one directory only'.
Google Maps in this browser returned only a 5-result 'limited view' per query, so Maps was supplemental rather than a completeness base.
Main Street Highland Park's official business directory page states it is being updated and currently has no listings, so the borough's own merchant list could not be used.
Overpass/OpenStreetMap API and Nominatim could not be reached (timeouts), so no OSM sweep was possible.

Several entries are the same storefront under two names (Ubry's / P & K Auto Clinic; Kam Soon / ArchAuto; Robert's Florals' two addresses; All Faiths Cremation / Jaqui-Kuhn; Durable Parts / Liquid Gold). Triage should merge or confirm.
Businesses on Raritan Ave or Woodbridge Ave near the Edison line may have mailing addresses in Edison; I only kept entries whose street address patterns match Highland Park's own corridors.
data_gaps: No verified list of NJ-licensed electrical, plumbing or HVAC contractors with Highland Park commercial addresses was obtainable without accessing license databases that return personal/residential addresses.
Highland Park Glass Co. (historically 176 Woodbridge Ave) could not be confirmed as operating - that address now appears to host the BLKBRN dispensary, so I excluded it.
Could not identify several small storefronts: 'Haven' (333 Raritan, listed as a hair salon elsewhere), 'Studio AAtelier' (329 Raritan), 'Greene Horizons' (320 Raritan Ste 202B).
'Appliance Repair Highland Park' (798 Raritan Ave #5) and 'Near Moving Company' (17 S 3rd Ave) look like lead-generation listings rather than real local firms, so they were not included.
Highland Park Bowling's street address was not captured; the venue's own PDF confirms operation but not the address.
Phone numbers are missing for many entries because the only source page listed name/address without a phone.
